name: Ulag the Cleaver
summary: In Tirisfal, a captive Scourge warrior tests the resolve of young Forsaken. Deathguard Dillinger sends you to release Ulag the Cleaver beneath a mausoleum north of Brill and face him in combat.

sections.title: A Bound Scourge Thrall
sections.body: After the Scourge swept across Lordaeron, the Forsaken captured an unusual undead warrior who called himself Ulag the Cleaver. His mind remained clear, yet the Lich King still held his spirit in psychic thrall. The Forsaken bound him beneath a mausoleum north of Brill with a magical seal. They hoped to learn how the Scourge chained a mind and to break the hold over him.

sections.title: The Executioner's Trial
sections.body: The Forsaken failed to free Ulag from the Lich King's command. Deathguard Dillinger now uses the captive as a test of combat for rising Forsaken warriors. Disturbing the skull stone outside the crypt breaks the wards and frees Ulag from his prison. A warrior must face him with an axe, granting him release through death.

faq.answer: Ulag the Cleaver was an undead warrior the Forsaken captured during the Scourge's invasion of Tirisfal Glades. He kept his mind and identity, but remained under the Lich King's command.

faq.q: Why was Ulag imprisoned under the mausoleum?
faq.answer: The Forsaken imprisoned Ulag beneath a magical seal to study the Lich King's control of his mind. They hoped to sever the psychic bond, but their efforts failed.

faq.q: Why do the Deathguards want Ulag killed now?
faq.answer: The Forsaken could not break the Lich King's hold on Ulag, and decided death was the only mercy left. Deathguard Dillinger made the execution a test of courage and discipline for aspiring warriors.
Ulag is held beneath a mausoleum just north of Brill. Touching the skull stone near the tomb breaks the magical seal, and Ulag rises to attack.

faq.q: Who gives the quest to slay Ulag?
faq.answer: Deathguard Dillinger guards the western road out of Brill in Tirisfal Glades. He sends Forsaken warriors seeking further instruction to face Ulag.

faq.q: What happens after Ulag is defeated?
faq.answer: After you confirm Ulag's death, Deathguard Dillinger recognizes your courage and sends you to Coleman Farthing in Brill to continue your training.

angles.text: As a Forsaken warrior, you face an early test of courage against a powerful Scourge champion still under the Lich King's control.
As an undead, Ulag's fate shows the horror of Scourge control: some Forsaken broke free, while others remain enslaved to the Lich King.
